_preprocessor_name_help: Optional. Class in preprocessor.py to use; only needed if it defines more than one BasePreprocessor subclass.
_model_params_help: Kwargs passed directly to the model constructor (the class named by 'model_name' in model.py). Model-specific; do not put any key here that the constructor does not accept.
_model_preprocessing_help: Passed whole to the preprocessor's constructor (available as self.config); it configures preprocess(), postprocess() and, for a dose-calculation model, predict(). Contents are model-specific.

metadata._help: Free-form: the loader ignores it. Use it to record how the model was trained and any assumptions it makes. 'task' is read by list_local_models(); 'training.modality', 'requirements' and 'dose_calc' are read by the AI dose engine ('AIBeamlet').
metadata._task_help: What the model does. Read by list_local_models() and the model suggestions of the GUI; falls back to the 'dosecalc-*'/'outcome-*' repository-name prefix when absent. Distinct from the radiation modality under 'training'.
metadata.description: Short human-readable description of the model.
metadata._requirements_help: Optional. Importable packages model.py/preprocessor.py need (top-level package names). For a plan naming this model, the AI dose engine reports itself unavailable if one is not installed, instead of failing mid-calculation.

dose_calc._help: Dose-calculation models only; read by the AI dose engine ('AIBeamlet'). Only 'grid_parameters' is required. The preprocessor must provide predict(model, model_input) returning {quantity: array of shape (batch, depth, lateral, lateral)} for every quantity listed in 'quantities'; see the AI Model Hub user guide.

grid_parameters._help: Required. Sampling grid of each beamlet: a cuboid aligned with the beamlet, centered laterally on its ray; all values in mm. The model gets the CT on this grid with axis order (depth, lateral, lateral) and returns its predictions on the same grid.
grid_parameters._lateral_range_help: Total width of the grid along each lateral axis.
grid_parameters._depth_offset_start_help: Where the grid starts along the ray, relative to the isocenter plane (negative: upstream, towards the source).
grid_parameters._depth_range_help: Length of the grid along the ray; it ends at depth_offset_start + depth_range.

dose_calc._quantities_help: Optional, default ['physical_dose']. Quantities predict() returns, e.g. physical_dose, physical_dose_var, let_dose. 'physical_dose' is required and must come first.
dose_calc._energy_range_mev_help: Optional [min, max] in MeV the model was trained on. The engine warns about energies of the plan outside it.
dose_calc._trained_machine_help: Optional. Name of the machine the model was trained on. The engine warns if the plan uses another one.

training._modality_help: Radiation mode (as in the plan's radiation_mode) the model was trained for. The AI dose engine ('protons' or 'VHEE') rejects plans using another one. Older models may declare it as 'dose_calc.radiation_mode' instead.
training.notes: How the data was trained / assumptions the model makes.
